findings.summary: Whole-file digest voids a run on any concurrent operator registry write and blames #437; the record keeps only a boolean (no before/after digests, no vfkb-xr-arm row delta). Fails closed (false RED, never false GREEN); same shape as #436 F1

Guard covers installed_plugins.json only; other operator config writes (.claude.json project map, projects/, known_marketplaces.json) are unasserted. In scope per #437 DoD; sandboxEnv covers them structurally

Re-pinned record carries no modelUsage/producedBy/digest, so a live run is indistinguishable from a fake run from the record alone (pre-existing gap; author observed the live run in-session: keychain shim calls=18, which a fake run does not produce)
claudeSync is inside the try at cross-repo-record.mjs:153-163, so a claudeEnv refusal scores as an arm miss, not an abort (pre-existing; false RED only)
Sandbox home is tmpdir()/vfkb-xr-home-* rather than #437's <arm>/home; justified (keeps the stub repo tree unchanged), cleaned on both paths, no leftovers observed
